title: Denial: knee arthroscopy, no prior authorization (complete notice)

reason.quote: We have denied payment for an outpatient knee
reason.text: We have denied payment for an outpatient knee arthroscopy because prior authorization was not obtained before the procedure.

denial_code.quote: Denial code CO-197: prior authorization was required for
denial_code.text: Denial code CO-197: prior authorization was required for this service and was not on file.

plan_provision.quote: This decision is based on the Prior Authorization
plan_provision.text: This decision is based on the Prior Authorization requirements in Section 7, Benefits, of your Evidence of Coverage.

codes_on_request.quote: You may request the diagnosis code and the
codes_on_request.text: You may request the diagnosis code and the treatment code for this claim, and what each code means, at no cost.

review_procedures.quote: You may file an internal appeal within 180
review_procedures.text: You may file an internal appeal within 180 days after you receive this notice. We will decide a post-service appeal within 60 days after we receive it.

appeal_and_external_review.quote: To start an appeal, write to Member Appeals,
appeal_and_external_review.text: To start an appeal, write to Member Appeals, PO Box 0000, Atlanta, GA 30300, and include any records that support your request. If we uphold this denial, you may ask for an external review by an independent reviewer.

consumer_assistance.quote: For free help, you may contact Consumer Services
consumer_assistance.text: For free help, you may contact Consumer Services at the Georgia Office of Commissioner of Insurance and Safety Fire.
